protein_names: Actual strict XML/HTML parser results; direct canonical source labels. Unnamed monomers are not supported by XMLfallback;13real issuingHTML originals supply their exact native labels.
native_participant_label_policy: MetaCyc canonical_or_synonym. Existing contextual MetaCyc rules cover record/reactions only; they do not permit arbitrary protein/gene participant labels.
uniprot_label_policy: UniProt canonical_or_synonym plus existing MetaCyc participant display-context rule. Identifier still must resolve; no strain/construct/assembly equivalence is implied.
assembly_policy: Exact native complex IDs remain distinct from component reference proteins; all coefficients and source uncertainty retained.
gene_policy: Independent nativegeneHTMLnames and full reciprocal nativegene/product slots establish exact source identity context. External GeneIDcounterparts additionally need issuing status, locus and organism/strain concordance. No gene is chosen only because its protein appears in UniProt.
taxon_policy: Pinned NCBITaxon canonical authority with direct original extraction; source taxonomy assignment does not establish whole-route experimental occurrence.
candidate_plan: Optional reference endpoints are not automatic graph additions. Root must select exact native/ref endpoint scopes, preserve existing owners and obtain independent scientific/technical review.
